searchText: hey <@755590043632140352> you are building your ePBS branch on top of deneb, correct? Yeah I think so So when your Deneb activates, you are activating ePBS. Oh I haven't written any fork logic yet <@504202741933932544> ok but if there is a world in which we do an ePBS devnet during the interop, it would be a DENEB fork, so spec could remain deneb based.. WDYT? It would be an epbs specific fork I think But built on top of Deneb mmm.. in that case the only thing that will save my time is to branch from the moment we had an empty ELECTRA fork on master and plug ePBS on it with empty I mean a copy of DENEB I'm not sure I follow, but surely having forking logic would make life much harder, I presume it would be much easier to start with genesis in ePBS. If that's not possible we could have Deneb genesis (which I am not even sure if Prysm supports) and then fork to ePBS. But forking from Electra would be harder because of 7002, MaxEB, etc... Prysm definitely doesn't have that electra branch yet at all No no, for me ELECTRA would be just the name of the next fork, no other EIPs in it other then ePBS stuff not sure if we can genesis from deneb too 🙂 https://github.com/potuz/consensus-specs/pull/6 here is the upgrade logic from deneb -> ePBS. Would it be possible to activate at a fork defined just for ePBS? just name it epbs_fork_epoch? ah nvm, just saw thats the pr terence made my current version of the slot anatomy looks very good to me, just a couple of comments: - in case you choose local building, you can publish immediately your block with the CL block. - ILs can be validated immediately and not wait for the block to arrive - Blobs can be submitted before the payload, as soon as you see the CL block with the commitment. Besides EP timliness, you also want EP validation. I see you have block and IL validations, but not EP validation If the builder is confident, why must you wait until the 6s mark to reveal the execution payload? Just like blobs, I dont see why it can't be revealed earlier as well I think it's currently implicit in the EP seen? but yeah, definitely need to validate it at that point Yes, the builder=proposer case is not fully explicit

looks very good to me, just a couple of comments: 
- in case you choose local building, you can publish immediately your block with the CL block. 
- ILs can be validated immediately and not wait for the block to arrive
- Blobs can be submitted before the payload, as soon as you see the CL block with the commitment.
